title: Trivy - Misconfiguration details
description: Failed config audit, RBAC and infra assessment checks with affected resources.

list.name: check_id
list.label: Check

query.query: query_result(count by (check_id) ((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_configaudits_info{config_audit_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "config_audit_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "config_audit_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "config_audit_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "config_audit_category", "(.*)"), "report", "config", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_rbacassessments_info{rbac_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "rbac_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "rbac_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "rbac_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "rbac_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "rbac", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)") or label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(trivy_infraassessments_info{infra_assessment_success="false", cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", severity=~"$severity"}, "check_id", "$1", "infra_assessment_id", "(.*)"), "title", "$1", "infra_assessment_title", "(.*)"), "description", "$1", "infra_assessment_description", "(.*)"), "category", "$1", "infra_assessment_category", "(.*)"), "report", "infra", "", ""), "check_link", "https://avd.aquasec.com/misconfig/$1", "check_id", "(.+)"))))

panels.description: config = workload manifests (config audit), rbac = Roles, infra = control plane and node settings. Remediation links to the Aqua AVD page of the check.
